question.text: If $\left(1+x+x^2+x^3\right)^5=\sum_{k=0}^{15} a_k x^k$ then $\sum_{k=0}^7(-1)^k \cdot a_{2 k}$ is equal to

solution.text:
$\begin{aligned}
& \text { Hint : } \sum_{k=0}^1(-1)^k a_{2 k} \\
& =a_0-a_2+a_4-a_6+a_8 \ldots . a_{14} \\
& \left(1+x+x^2+x^3\right)^5=a_0+a_1 x+\ldots . .+a_{15} x^{15} \\
& \text { put } x=i \\
& \left(1+i+i^2+i^3\right)^5=a_0+a_1 i+a_2 i^2+\ldots .+a_{15} i^{15}
\end{aligned}$
equating real part
$a_0-a_2+a_4-a_6+a_8 \ldots \ldots . a_{14}=0$
